summary: Roberta Sophia Rodriguez, 38, slipped on a rock and fell into the South Fork of the Rio Grande near Creede (Wolf Creek Pass, Hwy 160); fiance tried to save her but lost her in the rapids; body recovered ~10:45am after 10 days of searching.
location: South Fork of the Rio Grande, Wolf Creek Pass (Hwy 160), near Creede
responding_agency: Mineral County Sheriff's Office, Mineral County Search and Rescue, South Fork Fire Rescue, Colorado State Patrol
notes: Fell Saturday evening Jun 15; search ran 10 days amid high fast runoff; name widely published (SnowBrains).
